intent: An arena of champions: an oval sand floor sunk below rings of ivory stands, entered down a processional stair under a gate at either end, with a canopied royal box over the precinct, weapon racks on the sand and a gold medallion at its heart under a crown of rising gold motes.

critic.best_shot: feature-whole-final: eye-level down the stair to the arch and stands
critic.why: A complete, readable arena with a fine medallion; every seed is the same oval.

role: Landmark/boss court: arena for an elite or event fight.
notes:
# K

Keep: Keep the oval bowl, the sunburst medallion and the canopied box.

1. Vary the bowl: half-ruined stands, a round bowl, gates on different axes.
2. Put a few cover pieces on the sand so it is a place to fight, not just a floor.
3. Add gold to the stands' rims so it reads Domain, not grey.
